item.title: South Africa Petrol Price Impact: April 2026
item.description: Executive Summary April’s petrol price surge in South Africa is the steepest in recent history, with diesel and paraffin seeing record increases—affecting affordability for households and businesses. The hike reflects a combination of global supply constraints and government tax adjustments. Price Impact by Fuel Type Below are the projected price changes, highlighting the highest impacts: Fuel Type Increase (R) Projected Cost Diesel +10.13 R 28.67 Paraffin +11.63 R 24.17 These figures include both global price surges and local tax hikes.
